heading: A complete storage integration
text:
### A complete storage integration [NSTG.3.3]

Guidance, not a required shape, on top of [NSTG.3.2]'s obligations: keep
the backing-store handle behind the registered `user` pointer rather
than a global, copy the borrowed bytes before returning, index by the
`asserted_at` the argument carries rather than a wall-clock reading taken at
write time, and report an I/O failure as an error result (`DS_ERR_IO`) rather
than swallowing it.
